audience.notes: Australian couples in their 30s, AUD 150K+, planning a reception abroad (villa terrace, beach or island, vineyard, ballroom). They want a considered look, not a package, and fear paying a lot for something generic and planning from the other side of the world with no one on the ground. Paying parent wants reassurance that the outdoor and safety side is handled. Do not serve the bargain hunter: no DIY festoon shopping, no retail product picks, no prices.

payload.search_intent: Head term is transactional and local (hire, retail). Our target intent is the informational long tail plus image and AI Overview visibility: how to plan reception lighting that looks luxurious, works at a destination venue and photographs well.
payload.angle: A luxury reception lighting plan for a wedding abroad, built in layers (ambient, accent, task) and adapted to four venue types: villa terrace, beach or island, vineyard and ballroom. It times the switch from golden hour to candlelight, explains what reads well on camera, and shows the unseen work a Wedded Advisor coordinates: power and generators, wind and humidity, open-flame rules, and the crew's bump-in with the venue, photographer and band.
serp_gaps_to_win: Lighting a reception abroad: sunset time at the destination decides when ambient light must take over; nobody in the top 3 covers it.
Outdoor power: generator, cable runs, wet-weather and wind plans at villas, beaches and vineyards.
Open-flame and candle rules, with the official source at the claim (state fire services) and 'check with your venue' for overseas venues.
Lighting for photo and video (colour temperature, pin-spotting the cake and speeches, no coloured wash on skin).
A ready list of questions for the venue and the lighting supplier.
Editorial depth for the image pack and AI Overview, where only US and UK idea galleries appear.

outline.h2: How Wedding Lighting Layers Work Together
outline.answers: What do ambient, accent and task lighting each do at a reception, and in what order should we plan them?
must_include: ambient sets the mood of the whole space, accent picks out tables, florals and architecture, task lights the bar, buffet, paths, stairs and speeches
plan ambient first, then accent, then task
warm white over cool white for skin tones; dimmable where possible
keyword 'wedding lighting' in the first 100 words

outline.h2: Candles, Festoons and Chandeliers by Venue
outline.answers: Which statement lighting suits a villa terrace, a beach or island venue, a vineyard and a ballroom?
must_include: villa terrace: festoons or lanterns strung from existing structure, candles on low tables, the building itself uplit
beach or island: hurricane lanterns or enclosed candles because of wind, low-glare paths, no loose flame on sand without venue approval
vineyard: festoons over long tables, trees and barrels uplit
ballroom: chandeliers dimmed, pin-spotting and candles to bring the ceiling down
fairy lights used with restraint (fairy lights wedding secondary keyword)
candle wedding decor: mix heights, enclosed glass, check venue rules

faq.q: What lighting is best for a wedding reception?
faq.a_brief: Layered warm white: ambient first, then accent on tables and florals, then task lighting for paths, bar and speeches.

faq.q: How much lighting do you need for an outdoor wedding?
faq.a_brief: Enough ambient to light faces after sunset, plus path and step lighting; size it to the space and confirm power with the venue. No invented quantities.

faq.q: Can you have real candles at a wedding venue?
faq.a_brief: Only if the venue allows naked flame; in Australia, never outdoors on a total fire ban day (official source). Overseas, the venue and local rules decide.

faq.q: When should wedding lighting be turned on?
faq.a_brief: Before dusk, so guests never sit in half-light; time it to the sunset at the destination on your date.

faq.q: What is pin spotting at a wedding?
faq.a_brief: A narrow beam aimed at one object, such as a centrepiece or the cake, so it glows against softer room light.
